title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: The law defines personal data to include information identifying a person directly or indirectly, including a name, identification number, and other identifying characteristics. Confirm applicability before making a compliance determination.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: Article 2 sets out the territorial scope of the personal data law and lists exceptions, including government data and certain governmental entities and specially regulated data. Do not assume that every educational institution has the same obligations under this law.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
reference: Article 4 (Cases of Processing Personal Data without Consent)
text: Article 4 addresses personal data processing without consent and enumerates exceptions. An institution must establish a valid processing basis and applicable safeguards rather than assume that local storage alone provides legal compliance.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: Article 5 requires fair, transparent and lawful processing, purpose limitation, accuracy, correction or deletion of inaccurate personal data, appropriate security, and no retention beyond the purpose unless anonymized. These are conditional duties only if this law applies to the controller and data at issue.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: Article 13 sets out requests for information about personal-data types and purposes, decisions based on automated processing, recipients, storage-period criteria, correction or deletion procedures, and complaints. Determine applicability and any statutory exceptions first.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: Article 15 provides a request mechanism to correct inaccurate personal data or complete records, and an erasure right subject to enumerated conditions and exceptions. It does not by itself require erasure of every disputed record.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
reference: Article 18 (Right to Processing and Automated Processing)
text: Article 18 addresses objections to decisions resulting from automated processing, including profiling, with exceptions; the controller must involve a human in reviewing automated decisions at the data subject's request. Applicability and the provision's conditions must be checked.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
reference: Article 22 (Cross-Border Transfer Where Proper Protection Is Available)
text: Article 22 addresses cross-border transfers of personal data where an appropriate protection level is available, including jurisdictional data-protection safeguards or relevant agreements, subject to the provision's conditions. An external service does not by itself establish that personal data crossed a border; first verify what was sent, where, and whether this law applies.

title: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
text: Article 23 provides conditional pathways for cross-border transfer of personal data where a proper protection level is unavailable, including safeguards or specific exceptions. Check the full provision, destination, safeguards and institutional scope; this is not a blanket permission to send educational data to external AI services.

title: UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031
reference: National AI strategy, governance and infrastructure priorities
text: The UAE's AI strategy promotes AI adoption and national capabilities, including enabling infrastructure and governance. A strategy gives policy context; it is not itself proof that an educational application satisfies legal requirements.

title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
text: UNESCO recommends oversight, impact assessment, audit, and due diligence mechanisms to support accountability and traceability of AI systems throughout their life cycle.

title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
text: UNESCO recommends rigorous safeguards for AI systems that monitor learners, assess abilities, or predict student behaviour. Educational AI should empower teachers and learners and avoid misuse of sensitive learner information.

title: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
text: UNESCO recommends ethical impact assessment and oversight processes, including auditability, traceability, and explainability, before and during the use of AI systems.

title: AI Ready: Analysis Towards a Standardized Readiness Framework
reference: AI Readiness dimensions: data governance, policy, infrastructure and innovation
text: The ITU AI Readiness framework includes dimensions for data governance, digital infrastructure, innovation ecosystems, and AI policy and implementation. These are assessment dimensions rather than a national legal obligation.

title: OECD AI Principles
text: OECD AI Principle 1.3 promotes transparency and responsible disclosure, including meaningful information that enables affected people to understand and challenge AI-informed outcomes. This is comparative international guidance, not a UAE legal mandate.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act)
reference: Annex III, point 3 (Education and Vocational Training)
text: The EU AI Act identifies certain educational uses, including evaluation of learning outcomes and monitoring or detecting prohibited student behaviour during tests, as Annex III high-risk use cases subject to the Act's classification conditions and implementation timetable. It is a foreign policy example, NOT automatically applicable in the UAE or a legal classification of this prototype.
